decisions.subject: external clock and cutoff
decisions.rule: Host monotonic epoch drives external business time; cutoff stops new dispatch but never invents device completion; cutoff snapshot stays immutable

decisions.subject: typed ExecutionSnapshot distinct from legacy RunResult
decisions.rule: Reuse business facts and field meanings; do not coerce external sessions through legacy whole_window_computed or completed Run validators

decisions.subject: occupancy, modeled work and device-reported work
decisions.rule: Report each timing basis explicitly; unknown physical effective work remains null with a reason

clock_policy.source: Host monotonic elapsed time anchored once at first accepted run; prepared stays clock_started=false at0
clock_policy.event_order: Host admission_sequence; same-ms causal order retained; no insertion into committed past
clock_policy.device_timestamps: source metadata only; never subtracted from Host/Renderer clocks
clock_policy.virtual_mode: unchanged existing Engine virtual-window event loop
clock_policy.external_mode: explicit execution driver; process due modeled boundaries only up to Host elapsed frontier; no virtual advance to predicted work completion
clock_policy.restart: new Host epoch cannot append elapsed time to an old live epoch; unresolved previous session blocks conflicting admission until explicit reconciliation
clock_policy.activation: prepared elapsed stays0; first run fixes Instant once; pause/resume never reset; raw pre-run telemetry is not production admission
clock_policy.frozen_input_observation_ref: docs/06_v2.0设计与开发控制/冻结输入与执行观察设计.md
clock_policy.observation_freshness: V2-A10 probe issued/received in original Host epoch; expiry at issued_at+frozen max_age, never received_at+max_age; deadline affects only new dispatch

cutoff_policy.boundary_events: instant events at committed_at<=cutoff included; duration intervals clipped as half-open intervals
cutoff_policy.unpublished_work: stop publishing; release only genuinely unpublished reservations and record disposition
cutoff_policy.published_or_started_work: drain/query same attempt; do not release or redispatch by timeout
cutoff_policy.unresolved_output: preserve Engine pending output and holds; needs_resolution if not otherwise settled
cutoff_policy.cutoff_snapshot: immutable prefix selected by epoch/revision and Host committed time; raw device earlier timestamps do not revise it
cutoff_policy.late_receipt: may advance the live session after cutoff and appear in later snapshots; never mutate prior cutoff prefix
cutoff_policy.early_goal_completion: can close fixed-quantity session when all obligations settled; observed window ends then, no padding to requested cutoff

lifecycle.completed_guard: target accepted by original Engine rules and no unresolved attempts, reservations, business outputs or disposition
lifecycle.stopped_guard: new dispatch stopped and all admitted obligations settled or explicitly disposed; unmet target remains unmet
lifecycle.failed_guard: known terminal failure plus explicit recorded disposition; not inferred merely from missing receipt

execution_snapshot.snapshot_selection: all fields from one Host epoch/revision; cloud head publication and corresponding confirmed facts consumed consistently
execution_snapshot.authoritative_inventory_write: Engine only; cloud snapshot is read-only projection

frozen_input_observation_extension.clock_started: false in prepared; true only after first run
frozen_input_observation_extension.read: H09 local or explicit H08 C16/C17 cloud; fixed R/F/T

goal_and_comparison.goal_at_snapshot: accepted quantity from Engine at snapshot; independent from requested-cutoff coverage
goal_and_comparison.goal_at_cutoff: evaluated only from reached cutoff snapshot; otherwise null/unobserved
goal_and_comparison.completion_metric: Host-confirmed fixed-quantity completion; includes observed control/network effects and is labeled as such
goal_and_comparison.same_window: compare the explicit common observed interval, not a padded planned interval
goal_and_comparison.input_differences: report routing, equipment availability, accepted criteria and policy differences; no unsupported optimization or causal claim
goal_and_comparison.legacy_comparison: unchanged; new session views do not impersonate fully computed RunResult
goal_and_comparison.output_formats: one execution comparison/report producer feeds PDF, HTML, CSV and JSON

latency_evidence.original_target: device send to correct visible presentation p95<=2000 ms over 100 finite samples
latency_evidence.forbidden: subtracting unrelated device/Host/Renderer clocks or treating DOM state as a confirmed presentation frame
latency_evidence.preferred_evidence: supported same-clock correctly-presented-frame mapping if actual v1 measurement capability supplies it
latency_evidence.alternative_bound: one coordinator clock from a trigger known before device send until an acknowledgement known after correct visible presentation; report as upper bound including extra segments
latency_evidence.pass_rule: over the complete valid predefined group, nearest-rank p95 of conservative upper bounds<=2000 ms proves original p95 target; do not select only passing samples
latency_evidence.over_bound_rule: p95 upper bound>2000 ms alone is inconclusive for actual p95; preserve all samples and report what was actually proven
latency_evidence.runtime_evidence: none; actual presented-frame observation still consumes v1 accepted capability
latency_evidence.sample_group: 100 predefined samples; all need valid same-clock endpoints and correct visible frame; missing samples remain missing, never dropped to improve p95
latency_evidence.specific_probe_bound: 预定样本若具备probe_id到新采样receipt再到真实正确呈现帧的完整因果链，可用原Host probe issued_at作为发送前起点，以同Host时钟下晚于实际正确帧的有效确认作为终点；差值为保守上界。缺端点/帧/样本时不成立，不延长终态生产或删除样本凑组。

cases.trigger: nominal phase duration passes, no completion receipt
cases.expected: no output; no automatic virtual completion; real unresolved ownership remains
stop new dispatch; draining or needs_resolution; no automatic release/Completed
new live revision can change; original cutoff snapshot remains unchanged

cases.trigger: target met and obligations settled before requested cutoff
cases.expected: completed fixed-quantity session; observed interval ends at actual terminal time; requested full window not fabricated

cases.trigger: missing receipt or data quality issue
cases.expected: unknown state recorded; no zero/default completion or physical-work value
timestamps labeled by origin; no direct cross-clock duration

cases.trigger: only Host start/complete receipt times known
cases.expected: confirmed occupation may be known; physical effective work is null with reason

cases.trigger: snapshot while resource claim is open
cases.expected: read-only clipped view; actual resource remains held; no destructive release

cases.trigger: Host restarts with prior unsettled execution
cases.expected: new epoch; old session needs reconciliation; no automatic re-admission of conflicting work
same epoch/revision/prefix; no mixed counter/event/state generations
original validation, window and evidence semantics unchanged

cases.trigger: prediction and external execution differ in observed window or availability
cases.expected: explicit alignment and differences; no fabricated improvement metric

cases.trigger: six completed commands, five accepted outputs and one pending output
cases.expected: accepted quantity five; no target-completed session
point event included, duration clipping half-open; no extra millisecond fabricated

cases.trigger: device reports an old completion time after Host cutoff
cases.expected: Host commit remains after cutoff; old report not backfilled from raw device timestamp

cases.trigger: latency measurement only provides an upper bound
cases.expected: label bound; preserve original 2000 ms target and all100 samples; valid original-Host probe-before-send and actual-correct-frame-after acknowledgement can bound delay; over-bound result alone is inconclusive
